sources.title: Visit Saudi visa regulations: live country groups
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Visit Saudi country-group dataset is served by the Saudi Tourism Authority official tourism domain and is the current nationality selector used by Visit Saudi visa regulations.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The current country dataset contains no Israel record.

sources.title: Visit Saudi visa regulations: live route configuration
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Visit Saudi route configuration is served by the Saudi Tourism Authority official tourism domain and defines the available visitor routes for each current visa group.
sources.supportingExcerpt: At the airport or entry point, use a kiosk or passport control office to apply for visa on arrival.

sources.title: Saudi eVisa registration: regular-passport nationality selector
sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism Saudi eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live visa.visitsaudi.com eVisa registration page presents the Ministry of Tourism service's regular-passport nationality selector and application flow.

sources.title: Saudi eVisa registration: Taiwan regular-passport authorization
sources.publisher: Ministry of Tourism Saudi eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: This live authorization endpoint is called by the official eVisa registration page after a nationality is selected; selector record 205 is Taiwan China.

policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: Saudi eVisa registration
policies.summary: The current official Saudi eVisa regular-passport selector includes Taiwan China, and its linked nationality authorization endpoint returns isAuthorized 1. This establishes a pre-travel electronic visa application route for ordinary Taiwan passports.
conditions: The route is an online eVisa application before travel, not visa-free or visa-on-arrival entry. The portal's displayed visa fee is 300 SAR before any other applicable charges.
The registration flow identifies the passport type as Regular Passport and the selected nationality as Taiwan China; its authorization response is reproduced at the cited official endpoint.

This policy does not establish access through a third-country visa, foreign residence, GCC residence, package travel, pilgrimage, transit, work, study, diplomatic or official documents. Final issuance and admission remain subject to the Saudi authorities' application and border decisions.

The separate Visit Saudi nationality dataset currently labels Taiwan China noneligible. The live eVisa issuance portal is given precedence for the eVisa route because it directly accepts the regular-passport nationality and exposes an authorized application continuation.

conflicts.explanation: The current Saudi Tourism Authority country dataset has no Israel entry, so the previously promoted eligible-group classification cannot be reproduced. The generic eligible-group route content does not itself establish Israeli nationality eligibility. No new visa status is inferred from this absence; the pair is retained as unresolved pending an express current Saudi rule.

unresolved.reason: The current Saudi Tourism Authority country dataset contains no Israel record. Its generic eligible-group route configuration cannot establish nationality eligibility, and no current official Saudi rule found establishes a nationality-wide ordinary-passport visitor baseline. Conditional U.S./UK/Schengen-visa, residence, GCC-resident, package, pilgrimage and transit routes do not resolve this pair.

The live Saudi country dataset marks this nationality noneligible. No unconditional ordinary-passport visitor baseline is established.
